source_code_truth: UpdateSizingDay sets day_volume_multiplier to 1 + floor(max(0, stressed_balance - 100) / 150) at each server day.
NormalizedComponentVolume sets requested volume to 0.01 * day_volume_multiplier * component multiplier and rounds on the broker volume step.
InpMaximumPositionRiskFraction enters position_budget and protective-stop construction; it does not multiply component volume.
Aggregate admission uses tracked position budgets against conservative risk capital times aggregate-risk fraction.
invalidity.v1_behavior: V1 reset a period balance to $100 but rescaled each already accumulated source volume by candidate effective risk, including base-position-risk. It did not rebuild the candidate's own daily volume multiplier.
invalidity.decisive_symptom: The locked holdout emitted 0 accepted and 56 aggregate-skipped source births even though the V8 executable would rematerialize base volumes from the fresh $100 day multiplier.
invalidity.scope: All V1 candidate, plateau, validation, winner, whole-path and holdout numbers are invalid for economic judgment. Exact-source hash/net/DD diagnostics remain input-integrity facts only.

corrective_design.candidate_volume: Recomputed causally from candidate stressed balance, the fixed $150 daily ladder, 0.01 base volume and component weight.
corrective_design.position_budget: Candidate conservative capital * 0.04 * executable component volume multiplier.
corrective_design.aggregate_budget: Candidate conservative capital * candidate aggregate-risk fraction.
corrective_design.additional_exact_v8_input: The clean candidate ledger is joined one-to-one to all 965 lifecycle births to prove source volume, risk-capital and admission context before opening outcomes.
corrective_design.newly_blocked_or_freed_opportunities: Still receive no invented outcome; the accepted-source-path limitation remains explicit.
